title: Dahi Bhindi
method: Wash and dry the bhindi then cut into 1 inch strips as shown in the video
In a blender, puree the cashews and tomato till you have a smooth paste
Add oil to a pan and cook the bhindi till softened and cooked fully
In the same pan, add the ghee followed by jeera
Add in the onions, chilli, ginger garlic and cook till onions are translucent
Add in the cashew - tomato paste to the pan and cook for 5 - 10 minutes
Once its cooked, add in the besan and let it cook for 2-3 minutes ( raw smell will go away) then add the spice powders and bhuna it for a few minutes
Take the pan off the heat and add in the dahi and water and stir together
Add the cooked bhindi to this and place the pan back on the heat, allow to gravy to cook and simmer till it thickens and finish with kasuri methi and a handful of chopped coriander

Dahi Bhindi 
home food 101 | vegetarian 

Nutrition: 
C: 27 | F: 8 | P: 7
Calories: 210 per serve
Serves 3

Ingredients
1 tsp oil
300 grams bhindi
cashew tomato paste: 8 cashews + 2 tomato 
1 tsp ghee
1 tsp jeera seeds
1 onion, finely chopped
1 green chilli, chopped
4-5 cloves garlic, minced
1 inch ginger, minced
1.5 tbsp besan
1 tsp red chilli powder
1/2 tsp turmeric powder
1 tsp coriander powder
1/2 tsp garam masala 
1/2 cup dahi
1 - 2 cups water
1 tbsp cream, optional 
salt, to taste
1 tsp kasuri methi

Method
pre cooking prep
wash and dry the bhindi then cut into 1 inch strips as shown in the video
in a blender, puree the cashews and tomato till you have a smooth paste
add oil to a pan and cook the bhindi till softened and cooked fully
in the same pan, add the ghee followed by jeera 
add in the onions, chilli, ginger garlic and cook till onions are translucent 
add in the cashew - tomato paste to the pan and cook for 5 - 10 minutes
once its cooked, add in the besan and let it cook for 2-3 minutes ( raw smell will go away) then add the spice powders and bhuna it for a few minutes
take the pan off the heat and add in the dahi and water and stir together
add the cooked bhindi to this and place the pan back on the heat, allow to gravy to cook and simmer till it thickens and finish with kasuri methi and a handful of chopped coriander
